'''''[[Ninja Gaiden]]''''' is a series of video games released by Tecmo.

'''''Ninja Gaiden''''' may also refer to:

* [[Ninja Gaiden (arcade game)|''Ninja Gaiden'' (arcade game)]], a 1988 video game
* [[Ninja Gaiden (NES video game)|''Ninja Gaiden'' (NES game)]], a 1988 video game
* [[Ninja Gaiden (1991 OVA)|''Ninja Gaiden'' (1991 OVA)]], aka ''Ninja Ryūkenden'', a 1991 [[original video animation|anime OVA film]]
* [[Ninja Gaiden (Game Gear)|''Ninja Gaiden'' (Game Gear)]], a 1991 video game
* [[Ninja Gaiden (1992 video game)|''Ninja Gaiden'' (1992 video game)]], originally for Master System
* [[Ninja Gaiden (2004 video game)|''Ninja Gaiden'' (2004 video game)]], originally for Xbox
